grammatica.evidence: Educated policy-essay English: medium-long multi-clause sentences; parallel tricola ('A software company... a municipality... a hospital'); short punches ('This is wrong.'); no coinages.

dialectica.evidence: Path: unnoticed→dual strength (inertia+endorsement)→moral weight→reject zero-defaults→revealed-interest paternalism→heterogeneity→iterate→combinatorics→crypto/governance; not a single look-up or forced derivation.

rhetorica.evidence: Opens editor/font/form; retirement ~30/90; newsletter/tax; telemetry/ballots/organs; choice-as-resource; 80/20; living hypothesis; 10→1000 combos; closes crypto parameters / quiet governance failure.

arithmetica.evidence: Stock rates ('30 percent versus 90 percent'); endorsement and choice-overload claims; 'Choice is a resource'; default as 'living hypothesis'; engineers shape populations; crypto-parameter standard (few non-derivable atoms).

geometria.evidence: Single continuous unheaded essay: ~10 prose paragraphs, no lists/figures/sections; linear progressive block layout standard for longform op-ed.

musica.evidence: Long setup then short stress lines ('This is wrong.'; 'The incentives are wrong.'; 'It is the checkbox's initial state.'); parallel list cadence; paragraph-final aphorisms.

astronomia.evidence: Arc: ubiquity+thesis inversion→two mechanisms→stakes→false out (no defaults)→criterion→heterogeneity→iteration→interactions→invisible labor/incentives→crypto/governance crescendo.

notes: Public substrate carries nudge/choice-architecture facts; originality sits mainly in assembly and the crypto-governance close, not in novel empirical claims.
